soundness_flags.label: lem:learning / ass:monotonicity
soundness_flags.one_line: Monotonicity is unnecessary for the stated observed-law spline rates and score-remainder algebra; remove it from lem:learning’s dependencies while retaining it for identification and the causal class.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:finite-experiment / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact randomized coverage is asserted only for the explicitly profiled finite empirical-support experiment, not directly for arbitrary continuous Hölder laws.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The finite-experiment coverage claim is accepted conditionally on membership in def:finite-lr; continuous-law validity is supplied only by a separate transfer result.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:gaussian-recovery / honest_scope
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Gaussian recovery and shrinking diameter are restricted to the declared attainable class M_n^{LAN}.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Efficient Gaussian PN/PS inference is accepted conditionally on the primitive Hölder, rarity, and score-nondegeneracy conditions defining M_n^{LAN}.
